title: Design System: Spectrum Design Data docs site

body.purpose: Default paragraph and UI text at 16px / --spectrum-font-size-200.

shadows.name: drop-shadow-emphasized-default
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for emphasized surfaces (color-100, opacity 0.12).

shadows.name: floating-action-button
shadows.purpose: Component-specific shadow recipe for floating action buttons; y:4px blur:12px.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for most state transitions.

breakpoints.name: mobile-max
breakpoints.note: Observed in docs/site/src/assets/css; not a formal Spectrum token — this repo's own responsive cutoff.

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Spectrum's default accent-emphasis, fill-style button (variant="accent", style="fill").
components.css: .spectrum-ActionButton--accent { background-color: var(--spectrum-accent-background-color-default); color: var(--spectrum-gray-25); border-radius: var(--spectrum-corner-radius-control-m, 4px); } .spectrum-ActionButton--accent:hover { background-color: var(--spectrum-accent-background-color-hover); }

narrative.overview: This site is not a bespoke brand — it is Adobe Spectrum, rendered with the same @spectrum-css packages this repository's data produces for every other Spectrum consumer. There is no independent visual language to invent here; the only correct move is to use Spectrum's own tokens and components exactly as published, at their default light/desktop/regular-contrast values.
keyCharacteristics: Tokens over hex — every value traces to a real --spectrum-* custom property.
No custom component variants beyond what @spectrum-css ships.
This sidecar is a verified snapshot, not the source of truth — the published package and the design-data MCP tools are.

rules.name: The No-Invented-Hex Rule
rules.body: Never write a literal hex/rgb value into new CSS. Reference the --spectrum-* custom property, or once gen2 components land, token('token-name') via @adobe/postcss-token.

rules.name: The Verify-Before-You-Ship Rule
rules.body: Resolve exact token names/values with the design-data MCP tools (query_tokens, resolve_token, describe_component) before writing new UI — this repository is the literal source of truth those tools read from.

dos: Do resolve token names/values via the design-data MCP or skill before writing new UI.
Do use gen2's token('token-name') function (@adobe/postcss-token + @adobe/swc-tokens) once adopted — it fails the build if a token name doesn't exist.
Do re-run /impeccable document after a @spectrum-css/token package bump to catch drift.
donts: Don't invent colors, radii, spacing, or component variants not present in @spectrum-css/@adobe/swc-tokens.
Don't hardcode a hex/px value pulled from memory instead of the verified token.
Don't silently overwrite DESIGN.md or this sidecar — refresh via /impeccable document instead.
